_comment: Mutations for the integration surface, scored by its read and write cases.

mutations.name: an MCP key authenticates on the integration surface
mutations.old: WHERE key_hash = $1 AND revoked = false AND kind = 'integration' LIMIT 1

mutations.name: a revoked integration key still works
the bearer token is not trimmed
last_used_at is not stamped
mutations.old:
sqlx::query("UPDATE mcp_api_keys SET last_used_at = $1 WHERE id = $2")
            .bind(now_naive())
mutations.new:
sqlx::query("UPDATE mcp_api_keys SET last_used_at = last_used_at WHERE $1::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND id = $2")
            .bind(now_naive())

mutations.name: the camera list is not org-scoped
mutations.old: FROM cameras WHERE org_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
mutations.new: FROM cameras WHERE $1 = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC

mutations.name: an empty local_ip still builds a URL
a LAN URL is built for an offline node
online is derived from the stored status
the recording switch writes even when unchanged
the recording audit drops its via marker
status counts offline cameras as online
